messages:
Maya (AE): Hey team — Acme trial is hitting 5xxs during their ramp. Demo is tomorrow at 16:00 UTC, can we triage? Seeing spike ~14:23 UTC on our edge.
Sam (oncall): looking. can you paste the request id or logs? @deploy-bot, did any recent deploys land?
deploy-bot: Deploy roll 2026-03-18T13:50Z -> model-router v1.14.1 to region-eu. No failures reported. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dash/abc123
Maya (AE): request id r-0a1b2c3d4e. Customer sending long batched requests (avg seq 2048 tokens) and bursty concurrency (40 spikes).
Tess (SRE): autoscaler shows delayed GPU spinup 14:20-14:25 due to capacity contention on pool-dedicated-1. Queue length hit 180. That's probably our 5xx source. Any rate-limits applied by customer? 
Liam (Support): We have a short-term option: enable burstpool routing + apply per-customer throttling to steady out bursts. Also can route them to quantized model variant to reduce spinup.
Sam (oncall): agree. Can we flip fallback policy to prefer model-x-small when queue > 100? If yes I can apply now.
Tess (SRE): I can change routing policy. Applying canary now, will monitor.
Sam (oncall): executing CLI:
```
redwoodctl routing set-policy --customer acme --fallback model-x-small --threshold 100
``` 
Sam (oncall): Done. Also bumped burstpool capacity by +2 GPUs: `infra bump-burstpool --pool pool-dedicated-1 --count 2`
Tess (SRE): Autoscaler logs:
```
[14:21:05] scale-request queued=180 reason=backlog
[14:22:10] scale-action start=allocating 2 gpus
[14:24:32] scale-action ready
```
Tess (SRE): After the policy change 14:26 UTC, error rate dropped from 12% -> 0.8% within 3 minutes. 
Maya (AE): omg amazing, customer demo can proceed. Any customer-facing note I should share?
Liam (Support): Ask them to keep burst concurrency under ~30 for the demo or we keep fallback enabled. We can offer short-term increased reserved capacity for the trial (pricing = +20% for dedicated burst) — cc @maya for pricing.
Maya (AE): I'll relay. Thanks all :rocket:
Sam (oncall): filing a short postmortem doc and adding alerts on queue-length -> auto-fallback next time. 
Tess (SRE): will also add runbook step: if queue>120 and spinup >90s -> enable burstpool and fallback.
Maya (AE): will confirm with Acme and close the loop after demo. Thanks team :thumbsup:
